proposal.summary: The CI unit job would include the existing package test suite alongside its TypeScript syntax check, providing automated coverage of the documented inventory invariants on pushes and pull requests. Validation scope covers the required behavior cases and CI failure propagation; restoring the prior CI configuration is the rollback.
proposal.title: CI behavioral test coverage

summary: The supplied CI workflow shows a TypeScript syntax check but no test-suite step, while repository guidance requires focused behavior checks and the supplied test body asserts the inventory cases. CI omission leaves those checks outside the supplied automated workflow, creating regression-detection risk.
